lead: Cinematic film still of frontier work sites, dusty earth tones, hazard yellow gear.
notes: Mood-only mini images for HazardMissionTeam (2).html, beside the lore, game layer and feature text. SDXL (free): gen "HazardMissionTeam (2)-mini" --model sdxl --max 999, then finish "HazardMissionTeam (2)-mini" --model sdxl. Each prompt is the section's opening line; the images add flavor and never try to show a mechanic accurately.

images.name: vanguard
images.prompt: A small team in yellow work gear standing on a ridge above untouched wilderness, a city glowing far behind them.

images.name: crew
images.prompt: A row of rugged grey work robots with orange visors waiting in a hangar, an operator at a console.

images.name: site
images.prompt: Workers digging a tunnel into a hillside with lamps and a drill, a wooden lift at the entrance.

images.name: chain
images.prompt: A new steel bridge being raised across a canyon by cranes at sunset.

images.name: network
images.prompt: A sprawling map table showing cities, farms and roads spreading across a continent.

images.name: evening
images.prompt: A work crew relaxing around a campfire next to their parked yellow truck at dusk.

images.name: loadout
images.prompt: Crates, tools, ropes and a small vehicle being loaded into a landing craft in a dusty hangar.

images.name: operators
images.prompt: Operators in headsets at a row of control desks, each screen showing a robot's view of a work site.

images.name: contingency
images.prompt: Supply drop crates with yellow parachutes landing beside a half-built outpost.

images.name: monument
images.prompt: A tall new monument in the square of a thriving young town, people walking by.
